questions.question: Decorator ka basic model?
questions.answer: Outer function inner wrapper return karta hai; wrapper original function call se pehle/baad behavior add karta hai.

questions.question: Shallow vs deep copy?
questions.answer: Shallow copy outer container copy karta hai but nested references share ho sakte hain. Deep copy recursively nested objects clone karta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: Dataclass ka benefit?
questions.answer: Data-holding classes ke boilerplate __init__, repr, comparison etc. reduce karta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: O(n) se O(log n) better kab?
questions.answer: Large input me growth slower hoti hai, but operation aur data structure fit hona zaroori hai. Binary search classic example hai.
